description: Election Commission - Declare that M. L. M. Riyas was selected as the member of the Addalachchenai Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of selected members to fill vacancies caused by resignation or party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and candidate nominations for local government positions.
